Preview.//: Absolute cynara-web PREVIEW origins for OpenIddict redirect registration. Never hardcode a concrete preview URL here: each PR preview injects its own origin at deploy time via Preview__WebAppOrigins__0=<origin>. AuthDevSeeder derives <origin>/en/login and <origin>/es/login per entry; empty means only the localhost redirect URIs are registered.
